app.name: Alyte
app.tagline: A calm place for your laboratory history

onboarding.title: Understand your measured history.
onboarding.body: Alyte keeps your records on this iPhone. Start locally, without an account or a network connection.
onboarding.measuredBody: Imported values keep their source and can be reviewed before they shape a trend.

home.title: Today
home.emptyBody: Import a lab report or log an intake event when you are ready.

labs.title: Labs
labs.emptyBody: Your imported reports and measured history will appear here.

log.title: Log
log.emptyBody: Record food, drinks, supplements, or medication locally.

settings.title: Settings
settings.localModeBody: No account is needed for your local records.

snap.title: Snap
snap.body: Capture an intake image and save it locally before anything else happens.
snap.placeholder: Camera capture arrives in a later slice.

errors.title: Alyte needs a restart
errors.body: The local shell could not finish opening. Your local records are not changed.
